maps.name: Aircraft Carrier
maps.introduction: A cutting-edge super carrier, crippled by a “mysterious” collision during its Pacific transit, limps into a tiny tropical port for emergency repairs, and now rivaling powers scramble to seize its experimental tech. But neither side realizes a shadowy third party orchestrated the “accident,” and their trap is about to spring. Fight across a cluttered tropical shipyard dominated by the stranded carrier, and be aware of the moving barge. Capture its deck or flank through secret passages and a maze of naval warehouses. The ship hasn’t sailed yet but your chance to control it might.
maps.description: A tropical shipyard map centered around a grounded aircraft carrier, featuring dynamic elements like a moving barge and multiple flanking routes through naval warehouses.

maps.name: Blossom Crash
maps.introduction: A military cargo plane lies shattered in this highland valley, its wreckage scattered among blooming fields and flooded paddies. The prize? A stolen prototype point-defense missile system designed to intercept hypersonic threats. Rumors claim the tech was stolen from a cutting-edge aircraft carrier during a “routine” deployment, igniting a race to recover it before the truth surfaces. Speed-focused tanks dominate the open terrain, while snipers claim vantage points from a skeletal radio tower. Close-combat specialists can dominate in the canals, using stone embankments and burnt-out trucks for cover, but the plane’s smoldering hull periodically spews toxic smoke, potentially disorienting nearby crews. Secure the high ground, flank through terraced hills, or risk a frontal charge through the wreckage: every choice carries the weight of a looming arms race.
maps.description: Set in a spring-themed environment disrupted by a recent crash, this map combines natural beauty with chaotic terrain, offering varied combat scenarios.

maps.name: Nexus Dam
maps.introduction: Nexus Dam (Also known as Friendship Dam) was a “friendly collaboration” between one of two rivaling global powers and a developing country. Meant to provide electricity via modern power station to a brand-new town, the place is now a peaceful climate research centre amongst old caves that used to harbour insurgents – and just one good hit at a dam could start a catastrophe. There are plenty of high spots for long-range snipers as well as hiding places for heavier armored tanks to take those marksmen down. Dominate the high ground or crush still while rumbling through riverbed valleys and ramming snipers off the cliffs!
maps.description: An industrial map featuring a massive dam structure, providing vertical gameplay opportunities and strategic choke-points.

maps.name: Nord Oko
maps.introduction: Buried in the Arctic ice, this remote research station was built to study Earth’s atmosphere using a massive satellite dish and experimental laser. While officially for climate science, rumors swirl that the laser’s raw power could be turned into a weapon, a secret rivaling sides are desperate to control. Abandoned equipment and shattered trust litter the frozen complex. The towering satellite dish provides crosshatching line of sights, and its four rotating access tunnels force close-range skirmishes, time your push or get caught in the gears! Underground bunkers and ice caves let flankers ambush enemies, but keep in mind that it’s a night map, so threats hide in every shadow.
maps.description: A snow-covered abandoned military base centred around a massive communications dish. Fight through winding routes and rugged terrain that offers multiple paths for outmaneuvering the enemy.

maps.name: Scarred City
maps.introduction: A metropolis fractured by civil war, its skyline marked by barricaded streets, burned-out apartments, and a central square dominated by the headless statue of a forgotten leader. What began as protests over economic exploitation spiraled into chaos, until intel revealed a darker truth: a shadowy techno-terrorist cell has been fueling the conflict from the shadows. Now, the rival powers battle not just for control, but to unearth and seize the terrorist’s lair before it’s too late. Snipers and artillery dominate the wide-open boulevards and central plaza, while heavy tanks brawl in narrow alleys clogged with rubble and choke points. Take cover behind collapsed buildings or sneak through underground garages to flank enemies, but keep moving. Every corner hides a threat, or an opportunity.
maps.description: An urban map set in a war-torn cityscape, supporting multiple game modes like Conquest, Domination, and Plant and Defuse, with a dynamic kite formation base layout.

maps.name: Sunstroke
maps.introduction: A gleaming desert resort, built for luxury with sprawling hotels, a massive stadium, and half-finished water parks, could at any moment be turned to ruins as rival powers battle for control. What was meant to draw tourists with sun and spectacle has become a warzone amidst construction cranes, pools and glass façades. The flat, open terrain forces aggressive close-quarters fights around the stadium’s entrances and hotel courtyards. Heavy tanks dominate narrow streets, while flankers weave through collapsed construction sites and empty shops. Snipers can use sightlines atop cranes or rubble piles, but the lack of cover leaves them exposed to airstrikes that turn pools into craters. Sunscreen won’t save you here. Chaos will.
maps.description: A desert resort map with a focus on close quarter combat and flanking through city streets and construction sites.
